thread:
maria: Heads-up — ACME reported a hard error from our rerank endpoint: "dimension mismatch: expected 1536 got 1024". Customer says this started after a recent client-side model switch. request_id=rc_93f2b4e2a. They included the payload shape and a truncated server log.

alex: can you paste the curl they used (or a minimal repro)? also include which embedding model they used for query vs candidates — very often this is model mismatch.

maria: dropping the snippets from customer below. they called embeddings separately for query and candidates with different models.

maria (customer payload snippet):
```json
{
  "query_embedding_call": {
    "model": "text-embedding-3-small",
    "input": "How do I reset my password?"
  },
  "candidates_embedding_call": {
    "model": "text-embedding-3-large",
    "input": ["Reset password flow", "Forgot password link"]
  },
  "rerank_call": {
    "method": "rerank",
    "embedding_dimension_expected": 1536
  }
}
```

maria: server log (truncated):
```
[2026-03-12T14:02:11Z] request=rc_93f2b4e2a endpoint=/v1/rerank status=400 error="dimension mismatch" details="expected 1536 got 1024" model_checked=text-embedding-3-large
```

sree: yep that's the classic mismatch. text-embedding-3-small returns 1024 dim, large returns 1536. rerank expects all embeddings to share the same dim. we should repro locally: make two embedding calls with different models then call rerank; server-side validation should fail.

jamie: maria, can you confirm whether the customer used our SDK batching (auto) or did they manually batch candidates? if they used our SDK, we need the SDK version. If manual, need exact curl sequence.

maria: customer says they were on SDK v2.5.1 and were batching candidates client-side (manual). they attached a minimal curl sequence. pasting sanitized repro curl below.

maria (curl repro):
```bash
# get query embedding (small model -> 1024)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"text-embedding-3-small","input":"How do I reset my password?"}'

# get candidates embeddings (large model -> 1536)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"text-embedding-3-large","input":["Reset password flow","Forgot password link"]}'

# call rerank using mixed-dim embeddings (this should trigger validation error)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"request_id":"rc_93f2b4e2a","query_embedding_dim":1024,"candidates_embedding_dim":1536}'
```

alex: good repro. next steps: (1) confirm SDK 2.5.1 behavior — did it silently switch model for one of the calls? (2) reproduce on staging with same sequence and capture debug bundle. I'll run the repro and attach the bundle here.

sree: also add a small server-side check to produce a better error hint (e.g., include which call produced which dim). right now logs show model_checked=text-embedding-3-large but not query model. we can improve messaging in the validation path.

maria: customer requested mitigation: either we accept mixed dims with on-the-fly projection (not ideal), or we recommend they align models. for now they want a clear guidance doc and a sample curl to check dims before calling rerank.

jamie: mitigation runbook suggestion to share with customer: 1) always use the same embedding model for query + candidates; 2) if migrating models, re-embed all candidates; 3) verify dims with quick check curl:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"text-embedding-3-large","input":"test"}' | jq '.data[0].vector | length'
```

maria: passing along that check. I'm also going to ask the customer for the raw request IDs for the embedding calls (they gave the rerank request_id already).

support-bot: Reminder: customer escalation ticket #T-2241 linked to thread. Please upload debug bundle to /internal/debug/upload and post the debug_id here.

alex: ran the repro on staging, attached debug bundle id dbg_20260312_77. captured both embedding responses and rerank failure. sharing minimal stack trace:
```
ValidationError: Embedding dimension mismatch
 at RerankHandler.validateEmbeddings (/srv/runtime/rerank.js:132)
 at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:93)
```

sree: looking at the runtime traces — the kernel selection path is fine. this is purely an input validation error. I'll open a small PR to add the query_model field to the validation log and improve the 400 with a hint string.

maria: customer asked for ETA on a fix vs a docs workaround. can we publish the runbook and send them the instructions meanwhile?

jamie: publish runbook today. alex, can you draft the support note. sree, can you add the enhanced validation message PR and target it for next patch release.

alex: will draft the support note and include the curl checks + repro steps + debug bundle id. pinging @sree when PR is up. :white_check_mark:

maria: customer notified and will try the quick curl dim-check. I'll update ticket T-2241 once they confirm. thanks team. :thumbsup:
